Fnd_Hook_Out_ContextMenu.text: // ----------------------------------------------------// Project Method: Fnd_Hook_Out_ContextMenu ($table_ptr; $selected_es; $clicked_e; $row_i)// Called when the user right-clicks (or Control-clicks on a Mac) a Foundation output list.// This method builds the pop-up menu, shows it and acts on the choice. Without this method//   the list has no contextual menu.// Access: Shared// Parameters://   $table_ptr : Pointer : The list's table//   $selected_es : Object : The highlighted records as an entity selection, empty when none//   $clicked_e : Object : The entity under the pointer, Null over empty space below the rows//   $row_i : Integer : The clicked row (1 to the number of rows), 0 over empty space// Returns: Nothing// Created by Foundation on {{date}}.//   Foundation calls this hook. Put your code between the markers; the rest may be updated.//   Keep it shared: Foundation calls it from the component.// ----------------------------------------------------#DECLARE($table_ptr : Pointer; $selected_es : Object; $clicked_e : Object; $row_i : Integer)var $menu_t : Textvar $choice_i : Integervar $editLimit_i : Integer//MARK: Example code// See https://foundation.open4dshell.com/docs/out//$choice_i:=Pop up menu("Archive")  // Show your own menu instead of Foundation's...//If ($choice_i=1)//	// Act on $selected_es here, saving through ORDA.//End if //$menu_t:=""  // ...and Foundation then shows none.// The most records Edit offers at once.$editLimit_i:=10// A row that was not already highlighted has been highlighted alone before this method//   is called; over empty space nothing is highlighted, so only New is offered.// No classic record of the table is loaded while this method runs, so a record can be//   saved through ORDA without a lock error. The list is redisplayed when this method returns.// Item numbers: 1 New, 3 Edit Record(s), 5 Delete, 7 Show Subset, 8 Omit Subset.//   Every separator is an item too.$menu_t:=Fnd_Loc_GetString("Fnd_Menu"; "EnterNewRecord")If ($selected_es.length>0)		// Not localised: Fnd_Menu has no string for these labels. A disabled item still counts.	Case of 		: ($selected_es.length=1)			$menu_t:=$menu_t+";(-;Edit Record"					: ($selected_es.length<=$editLimit_i)			$menu_t:=$menu_t+";(-;Edit Records"				Else 		$menu_t:=$menu_t+";(-;(Edit Records — more than "+String($editLimit_i)+" highlighted"	End case 		$menu_t:=$menu_t+";(-;"+Fnd_Loc_GetString("Fnd_Menu"; "EnterDeleteSubset")	$menu_t:=$menu_t+";(-;"+Fnd_Loc_GetString("Fnd_Menu"; "SelectShowSubset")	$menu_t:=$menu_t+";"+Fnd_Loc_GetString("Fnd_Menu"; "SelectOmitSubset")End if //MARK:- Your code//MARK:- End of your codeIf (Length($menu_t)>0)	$choice_i:=Pop up menu($menu_t)		Case of 		: ($choice_i=1)			Fnd_Rec_NewRecord($table_ptr)					: ($choice_i=3)			If ($selected_es.length=1)				Fnd_Out_EditRecord($row_i)			Else 				Fnd_Out_EditSelection($selected_es)			End if 					: ($choice_i=5)			Fnd_Rec_DeleteUserSet					: ($choice_i=7)			Fnd_Rec_ShowSubset					: ($choice_i=8)			Fnd_Rec_OmitSubset	End case End if

// ----------------------------------------------------// Project Method: Fnd_Hook_Out_ContextMenu ($table_ptr; $selected_es; $clicked_e; $row_i)// Called when the user right-clicks (or Control-clicks on a Mac) a Foundation output//   list. This method builds the pop-up menu, shows it and acts on the choice.//   Without this method the list has no contextual menu.// Access: Shared// Parameters://   $table_ptr : Pointer : The list's table//   $selected_es : Object : The highlighted records as an entity selection, empty when none//   $clicked_e : Object : The entity under the pointer, Null over empty space below the rows//   $row_i : Integer : The clicked row (1 to the number of rows), 0 over empty space// Returns: Nothing// This method was automatically generated by Foundation on {{date}}.// ----------------------------------------------------#DECLARE($table_ptr : Pointer; $selected_es : Object; $clicked_e : Object; $row_i : Integer)var $menu_t : Textvar $choice_i : Integervar $editLimit_i : Integer// The most records Edit offers at once. Change it to suit.$editLimit_i:=10// A row that was not already highlighted has been highlighted alone before this method//   is called; over empty space nothing is highlighted, so only New is offered.// No classic record of the table is loaded while this method runs, so a record can be//   saved through ORDA without a lock error. The list is redisplayed when this method returns.// Item numbers: 1 New, 3 Edit Record(s), 5 Delete, 7 Show Subset, 8 Omit Subset.//   Every separator is an item too.$menu_t:=Fnd_Loc_GetString("Fnd_Menu"; "EnterNewRecord")If ($selected_es.length>0)		// Not localised: Fnd_Menu has no string for these labels. A disabled item still counts.	Case of 		: ($selected_es.length=1)			$menu_t:=$menu_t+";(-;Edit Record"					: ($selected_es.length<=$editLimit_i)			$menu_t:=$menu_t+";(-;Edit Records"				Else 			$menu_t:=$menu_t+";(-;(Edit Records — more than "+String($editLimit_i)+" highlighted"	End case 		$menu_t:=$menu_t+";(-;"+Fnd_Loc_GetString("Fnd_Menu"; "EnterDeleteSubset")	$menu_t:=$menu_t+";(-;"+Fnd_Loc_GetString("Fnd_Menu"; "SelectShowSubset")	$menu_t:=$menu_t+";"+Fnd_Loc_GetString("Fnd_Menu"; "SelectOmitSubset")		// EXAMPLE CODE: an item for one table only (item 9), handled below.	//If ($table_ptr=(->[MyTable]))	//	$menu_t:=$menu_t+";(-;Archive"	//End if End if $choice_i:=Pop up menu($menu_t)Case of 	: ($choice_i=1)		Fnd_Rec_NewRecord($table_ptr)			: ($choice_i=3)		If ($selected_es.length=1)			Fnd_Out_EditRecord($row_i)		Else 			Fnd_Out_EditSelection($selected_es)		End if 			: ($choice_i=5)		Fnd_Rec_DeleteUserSet			: ($choice_i=7)		Fnd_Rec_ShowSubset			: ($choice_i=8)		Fnd_Rec_OmitSubset				// EXAMPLE CODE: the handler for the item added above, saving through ORDA.		//: ($choice_i=9)		//	For each ($entity_e; $selected_es)		//		$entity_e.archived:=True		//		$status_o:=$entity_e.save()		//	End for each End case
